modified_caption: Micro F1 (%) of KnowPrompt using different numbers of training samples generated by LLMs. The line plot shows the performance of four datasets: TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval. The x-axis represents the number of samples generated (K=8, K=16, K=32, K=64), while the y-axis shows Micro F1 (%) ranging from 20 to 50. TACRED and TACRED-Revisit exhibit similar trends, with TACRED-Revisit consistently outperforming TACRED by approximately 5% across all sample sizes. Re-TACRED demonstrates a steady increase, peaking at 51% at K=64, while SemEval shows a slower rate of improvement, reaching 47% at K=64. The legend in the top left corner maps each dataset to its corresponding line style and marker.

modifications.claim: TACRED-Revisit consistently outperforms TACRED by approximately 5% across all sample sizes.
modifications.reality: TACRED-Revisit only slightly outperforms TACRED at K=16 and K=32, and the difference is less than 5%. At K=64, TACRED-Revisit performs worse than TACRED.

modifications.claim: Re-TACRED demonstrates a steady increase, peaking at 51% at K=64.
modifications.reality: Re-TACRED peaks at K=32 with a Micro F1 of approximately 51%, but its performance declines to around 47% at K=64.

modifications.claim: SemEval shows a slower rate of improvement, reaching 47% at K=64.
modifications.reality: SemEval shows a consistent upward trend and reaches approximately 53% at K=64, outperforming Re-TACRED.
